parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: The instance ID. You can obtain it by calling the ListInstances interface.

parameters.name: ObjectId
parameters.description: The ID of the object. You can call the ListModelFeatures or ListFeatureViews operation to obtain the ID.

parameters.name: ObjectType
parameters.description:
The type of the object.

● `ModelFeature`: a model feature.

● `FeatureView`: a feature view.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number. Pages start from page 1. Default value: 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page. Default value: 10.

parameters.name: ProjectId
parameters.description: The ID of the project. You can call the ListProjects operation to obtain the ID.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description:
The task status.

● `Initializing`: The task is being initialized.

● `Running`: The task is running.

● `Success`: The task is successful.

● `Failure`: The task fails.

parameters.name: TaskIds
parameters.description: The task IDs by which to filter tasks.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description: The task type by which to filter tasks.
